Object.fromEntries() — JavaScript — MDN

Transforms a list of key-value pairs into an object.

✦ AI Overview

The Object.fromEntries() static method transforms a list of key-value pairs into a JavaScript object.

It is essentially the reverse of Object.entries().

Syntax

Object.fromEntries(iterable);
